limits: Chromium only; Safari, Firefox and assistive technology were not tested.
200% uses Chromium device metrics: 1440 physical pixels mapped to 720 CSS pixels with scale factor 2. Native browser-menu zoom and OS text settings were not operated.
Independent text enlargement doubles caption and progress font size and line height; it is a controlled layout stress test.
Reduced motion is tested from a fresh page. Dynamic OS preference changes are not a supported result of this verification.
Frame intervals and long tasks are a 900ms local update sample. Observed approximately 132/133ms long tasks prevent any sustained 60fps claim.
Large ranking number stress changes only DOM text. It does not claim chart ratios or business data bindings for that injected number.
Ring data updates retain the existing spring and stabilize in roughly 1.9s in the measured poll; the 650ms mini setting controls entry timing.
No human visual gate, Git/Figma write, publication or business migration is implied.
